title: The Busy Family Planner
sub: Meal Plans, Kids Routines, Cooking Together and Pet Care Pages for Families with Little Kids
desc:
Five small systems for a calmer family week: weekly meal plans and grocery lists, picture recipe cards to cook with your preschooler, morning and bedtime routine charts, a gentle 'Ready for a dog?' family plan and pages for the family cat.

8.5 x 11 in write-in pages. Pet pages are a planning aid, not veterinary advice.
back: A calmer family week, one page at a time.|Meal plans · grocery lists · picture recipes · routine charts · 'Ready for a dog?' plan · cat care pages.|8.5 x 11 in write-in pages.
